    Uniform path nilpotence on the standard-form universal mesh #

    Path evaluation sends a string of arrows in a Hom ideal into the corresponding ideal power. Applied to the normalized universal-cover realization and the nilpotent categorical radical of a representation-finite module category, this gives one uniform length bound above which all universal mesh paths vanish.
